objective: Discriminate two materially different EndRing-PKE functionality mechanisms under a uniform six-obligation review, then test one gap-fed repair without scientific runs.

candidates.title: Alternating two-candidate EndRing PKE funnel
candidates.uncertainty: Can any explicit public-sender/secret-recipient mechanism recover the actual message and support a correctly directed reduction to the exact EndRing distribution?
candidates.positive_decision: Preserve a surviving conditional candidate and specify the cheapest next proof or implementation obligation; do not call it secure.
candidates.negative_decision: Retain candidate-specific breaks and feed exactly one decision-changing gap to a fresh producer; do not infer universal impossibility.
candidates.next_action: Dispatch the two mutually blind initial producer tasks, then snapshot before review.

ambiguities.question: Does a KEM-only mechanism satisfy this PKE goal?
ambiguities.resolution: No. It is classified separately and needs an explicit reviewed PKE composition.

ambiguities.question: Does showing that an EndRing solver breaks the scheme establish security?
ambiguities.resolution: No. O5 requires a solver for EndRing built from a scheme attacker.

ambiguities.question: How is an underdetermined interface scored?
ambiguities.resolution: Inconclusive/open, never silently repaired or recoded as a break.

attention_contract.decisive_evidence: Two complete scheme contracts, frozen snapshots, joint-owned independent reports, and one gap-fed revision review.
attention_contract.inconclusive_decision: Name the missing definition, sampler, lift, theorem, or simulator and leave that obligation open.
attention_contract.local_ambiguity_rule: Primitive and game are classified from the explicit algorithms; prose labels never override the interface.
attention_contract.rerank_trigger: Initial composition or discovery that both candidates depend on the same hidden auxiliary assumption.

resource_estimate.dominant_cost: Independent mathematical specification and security review.
resource_estimate.complexity_hypothesis: No asymptotic improvement claim; candidate construction only.
resource_estimate.sharding_plan: Two producers overlap, then two mutually blind reviewers overlap; snapshots and compositions run alone.
resource_estimate.stop_rule: Stop after the second evaluation and one scoped final composition.
